supportingSources.label: Pinrepair Buckaroo rules and machine account
Pinrepair Cow Poke add-a-ball rules and machine account

strategy.overview: Buckaroo and add-a-ball Cow Poke have two routes. Hit the roto-target until its lit numbers form a consecutive run, or collect A-B-C-D and then shoot the lit top-center rollover. Buckaroo turns those completions into replays; Cow Poke turns them into extra balls and also awards a ball from the red-dot roto target.
strategy.simpleOverview: In Buckaroo or Cow Poke, keep hitting the roto-target until the lit numbers form a consecutive run. The factory Buckaroo card awards the first replay at four adjacent spots, while the independent account summarizes five in a row, so confirm the apron and lamps. Your second route is A-B-C-D, then the lit top-center rollover.
strategy.summary: Favor whichever sequence already has progress. Repeated roto-target hits can extend an adjacent run; A-B-C-D creates a direct top-center collect. On Cow Poke, the red-dot roto-target face is an immediate extra-ball opportunity.

quickInfo.name: Roto-target run
quickInfo.summary: Light consecutive numbered spots; the first award threshold must be confirmed on the installed Buckaroo card.

quickInfo.name: Adjacent extensions
quickInfo.summary: On Buckaroo, each additional adjacent lit spot after the first completed group awards another replay.

quickInfo.name: A-B-C-D
quickInfo.summary: Completing the four rollover letters lights the top-center rollover for the edition's major award.

quickInfo.name: Cow Poke red dot
quickInfo.summary: The add-a-ball edition can award an extra ball directly when the roto-target stops on its red dot.

steps.text: Read the lit roto-target numbers and choose the shortest path to a consecutive run.
Shoot the roto-target repeatedly, using the backglass or playfield lights to track the run rather than chasing an unlit side.
If A-B-C-D is closer, collect the missing top letters instead.
After A-B-C-D is complete, shoot the lit top-center rollover for the replay or extra ball.
On Cow Poke, take any clean roto-target shot while the red-dot face can award another ball.

buildsToward.title: A consecutive roto-target run or lit top-center award

steps.text: Build adjacent numbered lights at the roto-target.
In parallel, complete the remaining A-B-C-D rollovers.
Collect the completed run or the newly lit top-center rollover.

cautions.issue: The factory Buckaroo card says four adjacent lit spots earn the first replay, while the independent account summarizes the goal as five numbers in a row.
cautions.response: Use the installed card and award lamp as authoritative, and treat the route as building the longest adjacent run rather than assuming one universal count.

machineSetup: Identify replay Buckaroo versus add-a-ball Cow Poke. Confirm the adjacent-number threshold, replay or extra-ball conversion, red-dot award, ball count, and any disabled awards.
Test the roto-target and every numbered lamp, A-B-C-D switches, top-center rollover and award lamp, red-dot switch on Cow Poke, animated backglass, bumpers, flippers, and tilt response.
